mapper.sql: select i.*, w.wbs_name work_package_name, t.task_name, u.nick_name owner_name, reporter.nick_name reporter_name, case when i.status not in ('RESOLVED','CLOSED') and i.due_date < curdate() then true else false end overdue from pm_project_issue i left join pm_project_wbs_node w on w.wbs_id = i.work_package_id left join pm_project_task t on t.task_id = i.task_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = i.owner_user_id and u.del_flag = '0' left join sys_user reporter on reporter.user_id = i.reporter_user_id and reporter.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(*) from pm_project_issue where project_id = #{projectId}
select count(*) from pm_project_issue where project_id = #{projectId} and status <> 'CLOSED'
select count(*) from pm_project_issue where project_id = #{projectId} and work_package_id = #{workPackageId}
select count(*) from pm_project_issue where project_id = #{projectId} and task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: insert into pm_project_issue(project_id, work_package_id, task_id, issue_code, issue_name, description, reporter_user_id, owner_id, owner_user_id, severity, status, due_date, resolution, create_by, create_time) values(#{projectId}, #{workPackageId}, #{taskId}, #{issueCode}, #{issueName}, #{description}, #{reporterUserId}, #{ownerId}, #{ownerId}, #{severity}, #{status}, #{dueDate}, #{resolution}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update pm_project_issue set work_package_id = #{workPackageId}, task_id = #{taskId}, issue_name = #{issueName}, description = #{description}, owner_id = #{ownerId}, owner_user_id = #{ownerId}, severity = #{severity}, status = #{status}, due_date = #{dueDate}, resolution = #{resolution}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where issue_id = #{issueId}

update pm_project_issue set status = #{status}, resolution = #{resolution}, resolved_time = case when #{status} = 'RESOLVED' then sysdate() when #{status} = 'PROCESSING' then null else resolved_time end, closed_time = case when #{status} = 'CLOSED' then sysdate() else null end, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where issue_id = #{issueId}
mapper.insert: insert into pm_project_issue_activity(issue_id, activity_type, content, from_status, to_status, attachment_name, attachment_url, operator_user_id, create_by, create_time) values(#{issueId}, #{activityType}, #{content}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{attachmentName}, #{attachmentUrl}, #{operatorUserId}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select a.*, u.nick_name operator_name from pm_project_issue_activity a left join sys_user u on u.user_id = a.operator_user_id where a.issue_id = #{issueId} order by a.create_time, a.activity_id
mapper.delete: delete from pm_project_issue where issue_id in #{id}
delete from pm_project_issue_activity where issue_id in #{id}
